carmen: Quick plan 10-day push2 for the 'Inference at Scale' webinar. Need X thread, LI carousel, and SDR seedlist. Who takes scheduling?
noel: I can run Hootsuite scheduling. Suggest times: primer 9:15am PT, main 10:45am PT, follow-up Thu 9am PT.
aj: I'll draft 3 X thread openers: hook, metric-led, and customer-story. Will need the exact metric phrasing for the metric-led one.
viv: Creative will produce 1200x628 banner + 1080x1080 image + 6-slide PDF carousel. Also can make a 2-frame GIF for the X opener.
carmen: Metrics to call out: "~30-35% cost reduction" and "2x+ throughput at similar p99". Legal asked for 'approx' before numbers.
official: (placeholder)
noel: Use UTM utm_source=x_tweet&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=iaS_jun2026&utm_content=post1. Ill append to links.
aj: Rough copy: 
- Hook: "Free playbook: scale LLM inference without surprises. Live demo Tue 11am PT. Register short.link/ias"
- Metric-led: "Approx. 2x throughput at similar p99; cut unit cost by ~30%. Deep-dive Tue 11am PT"
- Customer: "How Acme shipped their assistant with predictable latency. Live Tue 11am PT"
viv: Uploaded assets + alt text to drive: https://drive.redwood/marketing/ias_assets.zip
carmen: SDR routing: @sdr-bot please route registrants with utm_campaign=iaS_jun2026 to queue:webinar-social and tag:social_ias.
sdr-bot: Routing created. Matches utm_campaign=iaS_jun2026 -> queue:webinar-social, tag:social_ias, owner_rotation:regional-sdrs.
noel: Growth requested $900 for a paid push on the metric-led post. Recommend $600 on X + $300 reserve for Wed follow-up.
carmen: Sounds good. I'll ping legal for final wording and set a quick QA slot Mon 4pm PT.
aj: Will post copy drafts in the Hootsuite drafts and tag "needs:legal" when ready.
noel: Scheduling checklist: final copy per channel, creative crops, CTA short.link/ias, UTM, paid allocation, legal flag. Ill schedule by Mon 5pm PT.
carmen: Thanks everyone  meeting to confirm assets Mon 4:30pm PT. :rocket:
